name: Neural Chess v3.1 clean-distilled
trainingData: CC0 Lichess human games; distilled from upstream 37.4M-parameter teacher. No Stockfish training labels.
architecture: 8-block, 32-wide square-token transformer with four attention heads, geometry bias, policy and value heads.
limitations: Compact research baseline, not a demonstrated Stockfish competitor.
Published upstream strength estimates are not this experiment's measured ratings.
Raw policy probabilities are move preferences, not calibrated correctness confidence.
Full history is available only when infer receives a Chess instance or explicit repetitionCount.
adaptation: Unmodified upstream inference core bundled into runtime.js; local index.js adds chess.js adapter, stable legal softmax, optional history, integrity check and experiment-facing API.
